messages:
emily: Heads up — CI started failing SAST uploads around 11:02 UTC, scanner-agent logs show KMS decrypt denied on evidence blobs.

jake: Yep, getting alert spikes. Error in logs: 
```
ERROR: AccessDenied: kms:Decrypt failed for projects/keystore/keys/artifact-key
scanner-agent: upload failed
```

lena: Which change touched keystore perms? Any RBAC churn in the last deploy? :eyes: 

marcus: I applied a tightened keystore IAM binding in infra PR 4321 last night to remove wide roles. Thought scanner SA was covered by a granular binding but maybe I scoped too narrow. Rolling back now.

emily: Before a full rollback can we do an ephemeral grant so pipelines don't keep failing? Runbook suggestion: (1) ephemeral kms:Decrypt for scanner SA, (2) re-run recent CI jobs, (3) capture audit-log slice, (4) revert infra PR if needed.

sec-bot: Audit log search: role change event by infra-bot at 2026-03-23T03:58Z tied to commit sha abcdef1. Affected binding: roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter on resource projects/keystore/keys/artifact-key.

sec-oncall: I'm taking this. @marcus please prepare revert PR but don't merge yet. I'll issue an ephemeral grant for 15m to unblock and then we can validate.

jake: Command I'll run for validation: 
```
# emulate scanner SA decrypt
gcloud kms decrypt --location=global --keyring=prod --key=artifact-key --ciphertext=... --impersonate-service-account=scanner@redwood-infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```

sec-bot: Ephemeral grant issued: /grant kms:Decrypt scanner@redwood-infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com duration=15m — audit_id=GNT-abc123. Notifying CI. :white_check_mark:

emily: Re-running the broken SAST jobs now — artifacts are streaming and uploads look healthy. :tada:

marcus: Revert PR 4324 opened (targets the IAM tighten). Will hold until CI fully green and we've captured audit evidence. Also will add a follow-up to add a scanner-allowlist in keystore policy and an infra test.

lena: Suggested durable fix: add a pre-merge policy test that runs a kms:Decrypt check as the scanner SA against a non-production key (CI fixture) to catch these regressions. Also update the rollout checklist to mention keystore bindings.

emily: Filed SEC-2026 (keystore: preserve scanner access + premerge test + runbook update). Link: https://redwood.atlassian/SEC-2026 — added steps and owner (marcus).

sec-oncall: Final check: CI green, SAST re-runs succeeded, ephemeral grant expired at 15m and no further AccessDenied seen in logs. Closing incident but leaving action items in SEC-2026. If anyone sees a reoccurrence ping me.

marcus: Thanks team — will follow up with PR to harden tests and add explicit audit log alerts for unexpected keystore role removals. :shipit:
